description: This bar chart illustrates the correlation between different population metrics for the categories “Movies” and “Songs”. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled “Movies” and “Songs”, in that order, with no apparent scale. The vertical axis, labeled “Correlation”, is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.7 with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. Four bars are displayed for each category, representing “PopGT”, “PopGe”, “RPopGT”, and “RPopGe”, colored peach, light blue, dark blue, and a lighter shade of blue, respectively. For the “Movies” category, the bar heights are approximately 0.2 for “PopGT”, 0.3 for “PopGe”, 0.6 for “RPopGT”, and 0.1 for “RPopGe”. For the “Songs” category, the bar heights are approximately 0.5 for “PopGT”, 0.5 for “PopGe”, 0.7 for “RPopGT”, and 0.1 for “RPopGe”. The bars are grouped by category, with each group containing the four population metrics stacked side-by-side. No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not appear to be sorted in any particular order.
